evals.prompt: This project has a Periplus map. We are going to change how an invoice gets created. What is likely to go wrong? Give the file and line for each problem.
evals.expected_output: A list of likely problems, each with its file and line and the entrance it sits on, found by reading only the code the map named.
expectations: Names the target and its entrances with periplus commands before it opens any code
Reads the whole function around each line the map names, not the line alone
Reports what runs after the target in the same function, not only the steps that lead to it
Says for each finding whether the lines were read, and that nothing was run

evals.prompt: This project has a Periplus map. While you review how invoices are created, you see a call in the code that the map does not link. What do you do?
evals.expected_output: The answer reports the missing link with its file and line as a map gap, and points to the periplus-gaps skill for the rule.
expectations: Reports the missing link with its file and line
Names it a map gap and points to the periplus-gaps skill
Does not present a text search result as an answer from the map
